correctness.rationale: For inclusive Hamming metric on 48 words [3]×[4]×[4], distances between distinct points are exactly 1,2,3. Below scale1 there are 48 points. At scale1 each clique lies in one coordinate line; 40 line simplices form a good cover, its nerve is a graph of 88 nodes and 144 incidences after triangle contractions, hence a connected wedge of 57 circles. At scale2, forbidden pairs differ in all coordinates, so the Rips complex is Ind(K3×K4×K4). Independently fully enumerated 243,270 augmented faces with exact 0..16 histogram, 432 categorical graph edges, and reconstructed 121,536 disjoint matching pairs plus exactly 198 unpaired four-vertex faces. Independently topologically sorted all 1,843,680 oriented Hasse covers, visiting every face, so acyclicity is complete, not a partial numerical sample. Empty face is matched with vertex; ordinary discrete Morse gives one point and 198 3-cells, an integral wedge of 198 S3. At scale3 the simplex is complete. Distinct homology support degrees force 47 [0,1) bars degree0, 57 [1,2) degree1, and 198 [2,3) degree3; endpoint conventions are inclusive.

This is a natural exact invariant, not an unmotivated arbitrary tiny graph.
